title: Epic: mvp-review (MVP codebase review findings)
description:
## What to build
- Track the MVP review work as an epic and link child issues.
- No code changes.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md
- devdocs/mvp-review/plan.md

## Validation
- bd list --status=open shows this epic plus child issues.
- Child issues contain What to build / References / Validation.

title: Watcher: prevent batch loss when disconnected
description:
## What to build
- Fix watcher batching/sending so it never treats a disconnected state as a successful send.
- Ensure batches are retained and retried until successfully delivered (or explicitly dropped with a visible policy).
- In `watcher/main.go` review and adjust:
  - `sendLine()` (currently returns nil when `w.conn == nil`)
  - `batchSender()` (can clear a batch when all sends appear successful)
  - reconnect/close paths to ensure a failed send marks the batch as failed

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § A1
- watcher/main.go: `sendLine`, `batchSender`, `Reconnect`
- tests/integration_test.go: `TestLiveUpdate_SingleAppend`, `TestLiveUpdate_RapidAppends`, `TestLatency_FileToServer`

## Validation
- `make test` passes.
- At minimum these tests pass consistently:
  - TestLiveUpdate_SingleAppend
  - TestLiveUpdate_RapidAppends
  - TestLatency_FileToServer

title: Watcher: handle atomic rename + non-write fsnotify patterns for new .jsonl
description:
## What to build
- Make watcher reliably detect/read new .jsonl files that appear via atomic rename workflows.
- Expand filesystem event handling beyond only Write|Create to cover common patterns (e.g., Rename).
- Ensure new files created after watcher starts are discovered and sent.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § A2
- watcher/main.go: handleFSEvents(), readNewLines()/readFile()
- tests/integration_test.go: TestNewFileCreation

## Validation
- make test passes.
- Specifically: TestNewFileCreation passes reliably (no flake over repeated runs).

title: Watcher: robust nested directory discovery (add watches + scan on new dirs)
description:
## What to build
- Make watcher reliably discover .jsonl files in directories created after startup, including nested trees.
- Ensure directory watches are added consistently for newly created directories, and that any .jsonl under them are scanned.
- Confirm correctness when multiple directories are created quickly.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § A3
- watcher/main.go: setupFSWatcher(), handleFSEvents(), addDirectoryRecursive(), scanDirectory()
- tests/integration_test.go:
  - TestNestedDirectoryCreation
  - TestInitialScan_NestedStructure

## Validation
- make test passes.
- Specifically these tests pass reliably:
  - TestNestedDirectoryCreation
  - TestInitialScan_NestedStructure

title: Watcher: support long JSONL lines (increase bufio.Scanner buffer)
description:
## What to build
- Ensure watcher can read and transmit JSONL lines that exceed the default bufio.Scanner token limit (~64KB).
- Update watcher read path to increase scanner buffer or use an alternative reader.
- Add a regression test that writes a single >64KB JSONL line and ensures it is delivered.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § A4
- watcher/main.go: readFile() uses bufio.Scanner
- tests/integration_test.go: add new test case near existing scan/live-update tests

## Validation
- make test passes.
- New test passes and would have failed prior to the change.

title: Watcher: define backpressure/drop policy + observability for line buffering
description:
## What to build
- Document and implement a clear backpressure policy for watcher buffering when disconnected or under burst load.
- Current behavior: batchSender keeps up to 10k lines and drops oldest beyond maxBuffer.
- Decide whether MVP should:
  - drop-oldest with explicit counters/logging,
  - block until reconnected,
  - spill to disk.
- At minimum: add visible observability (log counters/metrics) so drops are never silent.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § A5
- watcher/main.go: lineQueue size, batchSender maxBuffer behavior

## Validation
- A short section is added to README.md describing the policy.
- Manual validation: simulate disconnect (stop server), append >maxBuffer lines, restart server; verify policy behavior is observable in logs and/or UI.

title: Server: add retention/limits to prevent unbounded memory growth
description:
## What to build
- Add configurable retention/limits to server in-memory storage to prevent unbounded growth.
- Currently server stores session.Lines and session.RawContent forever.
- Decide a minimal MVP policy (e.g., max lines per session, max total bytes, or time-based eviction), configurable via flags.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § B1
- server/main.go: SessionStore, Session{Lines,RawContent}, AddLine
- README.md: Limitations mentions memory usage

## Validation
- make test passes.
- Manual: run server, stream a large number of lines, confirm memory usage stabilizes according to configured retention.
- README.md updated to reflect the retention policy and defaults.

title: Server: gate per-line MD5 debug logging behind a flag
description:
## What to build
- Make per-line MD5 logging optional (debug mode) to reduce CPU and log noise.
- Default behavior should be quiet (log connects/disconnects/errors, not every line hash).

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § B2
- server/main.go: SessionStore.AddLine() MD5 + log.Printf

## Validation
- make test passes.
- Manual: run server and send lines; default logs do not emit MD5 per line; enabling debug emits them.

title: Server: harden /api/sessions/{path} path handling (decoding/normalization)
description:
## What to build
- Harden API path parsing for /api/sessions/{path}:
  - decode URL-escaped paths
  - normalize separators if needed
  - define behavior for ../ segments (reject or sanitize)
- Keep backward compatibility with current UI usage.

## References
- devdocs/mvp-review/design.md § B3
- server/main.go: handleSessionContent() path extraction

## Validation
- make test passes.
- Add unit/integration coverage for URL-escaped paths (optional) OR document constraints clearly in README.

title: MVP Implementation
description:
Implement Agent Session Viewer MVP: real-time JSONL viewing with <500ms latency.

## Epic Directory
All design materials are in devdocs/mvp/:
- design.md - Full architecture, protocols, edge cases
- implementation.md - Code patterns, snippets, implementation order
- tests.md - Comprehensive test specifications
- plan.md - Phase tracking and status
close_reason: MVP complete: all 7 phases done, 10 Go integration tests passing, 54ms latency

title: Phase 1: Server Foundation
description:
Create basic HTTP server with placeholder UI.

## What to build
- server/main.go with HTTP server on port 8080
- server/static/index.html (placeholder)
- GET /api/sessions returning {"sessions": []}

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 1: Server Foundation'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Server' for full API spec

## Validation
Can load http://localhost:8080 in browser and see HTML page.
close_reason: Server foundation complete - HTTP server, static HTML, /api/sessions endpoint working

title: Phase 2: Server WebSocket
description:
Add WebSocket handler and in-memory session storage.

## What to build
- WebSocket endpoint at /watch (gorilla/websocket)
- SessionStore with map[path]*Session
- Update /api/sessions to return stored sessions
- GET /api/sessions/{path} to return session content

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 2: Server WebSocket'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Server' for data structures and API

## Validation
Use wscat or similar to send a line message, verify it appears in /api/sessions response.
close_reason: WebSocket handler working, session storage implemented, API returns actual data

title: Phase 3: Watcher Core
description:
Build watcher that reads existing .jsonl files and sends to server.

## What to build
- watcher/main.go with CLI flags (--watch, --server)
- Recursive directory scan for .jsonl files
- Read files line-by-line, send via WebSocket
- FileState tracking (path, last line, last size)

## Dependencies
- github.com/gorilla/websocket

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 3: Watcher Core'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Watcher' for data structures

## Validation
Start server, start watcher on test-sessions/, verify /api/sessions shows the files.
close_reason: Watcher scans directory, reads .jsonl files, sends to server via WebSocket. Nested directories supported.

title: Phase 4: Live Updates
description:
Add fsnotify file watching and batching for live updates.

## What to build
- fsnotify integration for file change detection
- Read only new lines (seek to last position)
- 100ms batch ticker to collect and send lines
- Handle file truncation (reset to beginning)

## Dependencies
- github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 4: Live Updates' + 'Batching Implementation'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Watcher' for edge cases

## Validation
Append line to .jsonl file, verify it appears in /api/sessions within ~200ms.
close_reason: fsnotify integrated, file modifications detected, new lines sent to server, new files detected

title: Phase 5: Browser Live View
description:
Add SSE streaming and browser live updates.

## What to build
- GET /api/sessions/{path}/stream SSE endpoint
- Broadcast LineEvent to SSE clients when lines received
- SSE client in index.html (EventSource)
- Update UI when lines arrive

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 5: Browser Live View' + 'SSE Broadcasting'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Server → Browser (SSE)' for event format

## Validation
Open browser, watch a session, append to file, see update appear live.
close_reason: SSE endpoint working, browser receives live updates, auto-scroll implemented

title: Phase 6: Polish
description:
Polish UI and add error handling.

## What to build
- Auto-scroll (on by default, disable on scroll up, re-enable at bottom)
- Live indicators (green dot = active, gray = idle >5s)
- Error banners for connection failures
- Reconnection logic (watcher: exponential backoff; browser: retry SSE)

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 6: Polish'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Web UI' for UI layout, § 'Error Handling'

## Validation
- Kill server, verify watcher reconnects
- Scroll up, verify auto-scroll stops
- Full manual testing checklist in devdocs/mvp/implementation.md
close_reason: Added watcher reconnection with backoff, global SSE stream, buffer management, error handling

title: Phase 7: Testing
description:
Run comprehensive test suite and measure performance.

## What to do
- Run all tests from devdocs/mvp/tests.md
- Fix any failures
- Measure latency (target: <500ms file write → browser)
- Document any deviations from spec

## References
- devdocs/mvp/tests.md - Full test specifications
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Performance Targets'

## Validation
All tests pass. Latency measured and documented. README updated if needed.
close_reason: All MVP tests passing: initial scan, live updates, file creation, content retrieval, latency 133ms
